statement: The nine complete intrinsic cubic cusp-family obstruction maps at the wild prime, their exact parameter kernels and cokernels, convergent particular lifts and every third-stage geometric-conjugacy fibre.
manuscript_passages: Section51.16; folios733v-736v; scans172-178; formulas371-379; Part E(c),(d), follow-up(4)
notes: Actual cusp paths give full N-sections. All45 right second-commutator variations give intrinsic class-two sections, with exact full residual gauge (I-T2)A2^J. The actual third-degree error is7[z,d_i] in the330-dimensional intrinsic lattice. Its images are C3^11*C9^3 at A0,B0,O and C3^22*C9^7*C27 at the other six cusps. The complete liftable parameter groups are Z3^24*C3^3*C9^4 and Z3^24*C3^6, respectively. All nine maps have explicit exact lattice/Smith inverses, actual central corrections and full H1 lifting fibres. The elliptic commutator gives a literal nonlifting parameter at every cusp. The sum of these images has group C3^61*C9^25*C27^2 and residual quotient C3^11*C9. Remaining intrinsic, global, higher and other-primary questions are retained.
